label: The voltage tolerance band
subgoals: Take the larger magnitude of the two iterates
Multiply it by RELTOL and add VNTOL
Compare the change between iterates with the band

label: Quadratic convergence in iterations
subgoals: Square the current error and multiply by the constant
Repeat until the error falls below the tolerance

label: The current tolerance
subgoals: Take the larger magnitude of the two current iterates
Multiply it by RELTOL and add ABSTOL
Express the band in the unit of the current
